profile.headline: Software architect, OS X and iOS developer, experienced agile developer, teacher of technology.
profile.summary:
Software architect, OS X and iOS developer, experienced agile developer, teacher of technology and serial startup junkie who loves hiking and mountain biking.

Experienced at developing Mobile, Desktop, Client/Server and Distributed applications on Mac, Windows, Linux and various embedded platforms. Fluent in C/C++, C# and Objective-C programming languages. Knowledge of Python, Perl, JavaScript and PHP scripting languages. Frameworks used include Cocoa, UIKit, MFC, ATL, Qt, QtopiaCore, Boost and STL.

Specialties: Framework development, Software systems architecture, Rapid technology adoption, Cross-platform development.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: We offer a series of weekend courses focused on helping you develop practical skills building mobile applications that run on modern iOS devices (iPhone, iPod Touch, iPad). Our philosophy is that developers learn best by doing so we design each course as a series of hands-on exercises all focused on aspects of building a real-world mobile application.  Visit http://www.iosweekend.com for more details.

positions.title: Founder, Chief Executive Officer
positions.description:
FocalShift provides contract software development, project management, and architectural guidance for clients developing native "mobile-first" applications. We specialize in the design and implementation of mobile software solutions for iOS devices and develop Linux-based backend web services in support of connected mobile apps.

FocalShift can partner with you to develop an idea from start to finish, take a technical leadership role working with your team as you transition to iOS development, or help you bridge a short- or long-term resource gap by joining your team. We can also custom tailor our iOS training courses to your needs.

positions.title: Technical Director of Platform Services
positions.description: Responsible for software development activities in San Jose office. Teams here are developing large-scale consumer web applications using the latest Microsoft technologies.

positions.title: CEO / Software Architect
positions.description: Consulting firm offering technology consulting, contract software development and technical training for over 15 years. Focus is on development of desktop and mobile software for Apple Mac OS X and iOS.  Expert development skills in Objective-C, Cocoa, Cocoa Touch and the Objective-C dynamic runtime. If you have a need for low level swizzling or "creative" coding on Apple's platforms please contact me.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing software to support a new class of computing device (zero-desktop client) that will revolutionize server-based computing for the entire enterprise market.

In stealth mode the company was known by the name Atto Devices, Inc.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Responsible for digital circuit simulation tools used in SoC system design.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Primary responsibility for architecture, design, and development of QualityInsight and C-Insight, two Microsoft SQL Server focused products for Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence rapid solution development.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Responsible for the design and implementation of a PACS-like system that processed medical transactions (prescriptions, lab orders, eligibility checks, etc.) and performed patient visit charge capture on the WIndows platform.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for development of supply chain planning software.

positions.title: Software Team Lead
positions.description: Responsible for development of knowledge management system architecture used to manage a taxonomy of corporate knowledge culled from unstructured business communications.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Responsible for development of Radiation Oncology Treatment Planning Systems running on Windows.

positions.title: Embedded Systems Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for development of Doppler Weather Radar antenna control software and DSP signal processing data acquisition software.  Embedded system ran on Sun VME boards with custom DSP boards.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for development of Automobile Finance software systems running on Unix and Windows platforms.
